summary.result: In this study, to investigate of the effect of geotextiles reinforced slope of the embankment on a very soft foundation, a limit equilibrium analysis program calculating the safety factor of embankment on very soft foundation was developed.
summary.background: In the past, however, its design and construction have been performed empirically.
summary.method: And the 4imit equilibrium analysis program was written on the basis of Low's slope stability theory with some modification.
